standard_prerequisites.name: The Uhlenbeck partial compactifications X_zeta^circ, X_zeta^bullet and X_0 = C^2/Gamma and the moduli spaces M_zeta^circ, M_zeta^bullet, M_0 attached to them

standard_prerequisites.name: The Weyl group of the affine root system, the elements alpha^c_h and e_i, and the weights of the irreducible integrable highest weight module V(w)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used in the statement at source lines 2269-2278 and inside the proof; the author's earlier Theorem at source lines 1219-1243 (label thm:CB) is the criterion the proof applies
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the objects appearing in the two sets of inequalities and the alternative description by weights of V(w) in part (2).

core_obligations: The forward direction: if the regular part of the zeta^bullet moduli space at (v,w) is non-empty then, by part (2) of the author's Theorem thm:CB, w - v is a weight of the irreducible integrable highest weight module V(w), and the two families of inequalities hold because the weight has nonnegative entries for the chosen parameters (proof lines 2285-2290).

The structural input: the proof is organised so that the four cases of the affine quiver are treated through the author's earlier criterion rather than by the case analysis of the cited paper (the author states this choice explicitly at the start of the proof, proof lines 2281-2284).

The converse direction: assuming the weight condition together with the two families of inequalities, the proof verifies the hypotheses of the author's criterion so that the regular part is non-empty (proof lines 2290-2327).

The role of the two cases lsp{t}{delta} w = 1 and lsp{t}{delta} w >= 2: they decide whether the necessary condition is the Weyl group orbit condition of part (1) or the weight condition of part (2), and the proof treats them accordingly (statement lines 2264-2278).
proof_roadmap: 正向：若 Mreg_{zeta^bullet}(v,w) 非空，由作者前文的 thm:CB(2) 得 w - v 是 V(w) 的权，再由参数与正性得到两组不等式。
反向：在两组不等式与权条件成立时逐条验证 thm:CB 的假设，从而得到 Mreg_{zeta^bullet}(v,w) 非空；作者明说不用被引论文的逐情形论证，而用自己的判据。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the non-emptiness criterion for the regular part of the affine-quiver moduli space (author Proposition at source lines 2262-2279, label prop:affinemodulistrata), split into the two cases lsp{t}{delta} w = 1 and lsp{t}{delta} w >= 2 and formulated through the Weyl group orbit condition of part (1) and the weights of the irreducible integrable module V(w) of part (2), together with two families of dominance inequalities. The proof (source lines 2281-2327) deliberately abandons the case analysis of the cited paper and instead verifies the hypotheses of the author's own earlier criterion thm:CB for the two directions (proof lines 2281-2290), so the work is in matching the two formulations: identifying w - v as a weight of V(w) and checking that the weights have nonnegative entries against the chosen parameters. H2.
